name: visual-studio-extension
description: Build, deploy, theme, and shut down out-of-process VisualStudio.Extensibility extensions with Remote UI, add OAuth sign-in, and review changes with a read-only reviewer agent.

interface.longDescription: Skills for VisualStudio.Extensibility extensions: project setup and Extensibility SDK build errors, SDK-managed F5 and Experimental Instance cleanup with approval gates, packaged-VSIX validation, clean shutdown, Remote UI theming with Visual Studio color tokens, and public-client OAuth sign-in. Includes a read-only reviewer agent.
defaultPrompt: Why does my out-of-process extension fail with CEE0028?
The Experimental Instance still runs my old command.
Make this Remote UI tool window follow the Visual Studio theme.
